correctness.rationale: For each fixed record-position fiber the product action of symmetric groups on maximal nonrecord blocks preserves the event and makes block-relative orders independent uniforms. The exact boundary decomposition yields the Eulerian PGF; adjacent-descent covariances give the moments. An optimization over positive compositions of the number of nonrecords into at most the number of records proves both sharp attained bounds, including all small/boundary cases. Reproducibility checks use 1,151 exact integer/rational assertions across full permutation enumeration to n=9 and all record patterns to n=15.

value.rationale: A natural probabilistic question is the distribution of local order fluctuations after the positions of all upper records are observed. The result answers this full conditional-law problem, then gives a complete sharp variance envelope at fixed record count. It distinguishes conditioning on the full record pattern from conditioning merely on the record total, and explicit equality configurations explain how placement of records changes uncertainty. No unproved downstream hypothesis-testing consequences are asserted.
